instruction.text: Read the chapter, then answer the reading comprehension questions.

atoms.text: It’s been a normal day so far. I don’t feel differently. I guess some days you just can’t predict what will happen. I know that everything can change from one breath to another. That’s how it feels. From one breath to the next, I am up and asking to join the football game. Honestly, I didn’t even know I was thinking about it, but my body knew what to do.

I walk over to the field just as they are switching players and ask to join a team. At first, the other kids just look at me, so I repeat the question. A nice girl, Alicia, who looks like she is going into the game, gives me her spot. And just like that, I am running up and down the field again like I haven’t done in a year.

Everything is happening really fast, and I struggle to get my bearings. I realise that I should play in defence as Jake sprints by with the ball and scores in my goal. Why does Jake always have to be so good at everything? Everyone likes him, and he seems to like everyone. Except me. Everything comes easily to him. Then, I realise how I’m feeling. Angry. Furious. It washes over me. In my mind I see Jake’s nose turn up when he sees me on the bus, ignore me during the day and make fun of me behind my back.

He dribbles up to me again. From the look on his face he thinks he’s going to have another easy goal. I run up and tackle him hard. It is definitely not allowed in the rules of the game, but I can’t help myself. Then, we’re really fighting. I have no idea what’s happening, but I think I feel blood and I know I want Jake to feel every piece of how bad I’m feeling.

Next thing I know, a teacher pulls me back. I’m still not really hearing anything and feel out of my body somehow. I start walking, following the teachers, and Jake is right next to me looking scared and also in pain. Blood runs down from his knees and I admit to feeling good for a second.

Oh man, I am in for it now.

atoms.a: What thoughts does Norbert have when he is feeling angry?
b: ++He is thinking about Jake and how Jake is mean to him.
He is thinking about how frustrating school is.
Norbert scores on the wrong goal.

atoms.a: How does Norbert feel about getting into a fight with Jake?
b: ++He is a bit happy to see Jake is hurt too, but also nervous about the consequences.
He feels like he finally did the right thing and wonders why he didn’t try it sooner.
He feels awful that Jake is bleeding and not too worried about talking to the teachers.
